related_questions.question: How much retirement do you get after 40 years in the military?
related_questions.snippet: Your pension is based on this formula: 2.5% × years of service × your final monthly basic pay. For example, if you retire after 40 years of active service, the calculation would be 2.5% × 40 = 100%. You would receive 100% of your monthly base pay as your retirement pension.
